description:
Render Mermaid diagram code to SVG and/or PNG: flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie, mindmap, timeline and more. Invalid syntax returns HTTP 400 with the Mermaid parse error (not charged), so an agent can fix and retry. Params: code (Mermaid source, required), format (svg default, png or both), theme (default, dark, neutral, forest, base), width (200 to 4000, default 1200), background. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"code":"flowchart LR
  A[Agent] -->|HTTP 402| B(agentsvc.io)
  B --> C{Paid?}
  C -->|yes| D[JSON result]","format":"svg"}.
name: diagram_render
title: Diagram Rendering (Mermaid)
